summary: Round 12 baseline (HEAD 4f006d2). From the aisle the room is unchanged and still clearly the same product: q06 against c_27312, q09 against c_27313/14, q10 against c_27315. The nested pairs, monument, spine and cap, ash panels in charcoal frames, monitors and ottomans all read correctly. Since w11 three things are fixed. (1) The teal belt now shows on the O cushion (o1, r7). (2) The plaques sit at the two ends of the cap. (3) The cap is darker and the spine stays clear of the centreline fins (r5). In the studio the seat fabric now matches c_27315 in hue (r7 back #9a94a5: b-r +11, r-g +6; c_27315 (94,89,104): +10, +5). Flap/back is 1.22, against ~1.3 in the photos. Four things hold the score below 8.5. (a) The O comforter is still a narrow tongue. Where the bed narrows beside the table, 4-5 parallel diagonal ripples bunch up next to the pillow (r9 zoom). This is aliasing: a fixed-x stitch dip about 2 cm wide is sampled on grid columns that run diagonally there. Only one cross of quilt seams shows. tpg_81 shows a thin royal-blue duvet with faint 0.3 m boxes, draped wide with straight hems. (b) Both comforters have a regular pie-crust scalloped free edge (o3 E, r9 O); the hems in tpg_81 are straight. (c) The pillow flange renders almost white: o5 flange #d9d5d0 against a white pillow at #f4f3f2, a ratio of 0.89. In kn_17 (new, KN Aviation) and tpg_81 it is a dark grey-taupe piping, about 0.4-0.5x the white pillow. (d) The buckle is hidden under the navy slipper pouch, and the belt is a short flat slab in mid-cushion. kn_17 and c_27315 show a dark teal strap running from the seat crease, with a large silver buckle in plain view at its front end. The ash grain measurement has not moved (q06 0.053/0.065, q10 0.079; c_27312 0.11-0.16, c_27315 0.10, tpg_81 0.05). The main working tree has uncommitted ash and pillow tile work in progress, so it was not rated. Lighting (not scored): the cabin views still carry a cool cast, with the seat fabric at #4c505d (g>r) in q09.

issues.detail: O comforter: aliasing ripple cluster beside the pillow; the sheet is still a narrow tongue
issues.problem: In duvetSheet the stitch dip, 0.020*exp(-(dq/0.024)^2), is a fixed-x line about 2 cm wide. Where the O bounds narrow (a = smooth(-0.74, -0.60, z) takes xr from 0.31 to -0.03 over 14 cm), the 36 grid columns run diagonally. The narrow dip is sampled as a staircase, and 4-5 short parallel ridges appear where the longitudinal and transverse seams cross next to the pillow. Past that point the sheet is a 0.38 m tongue with white pad on both sides. tpg_81 has a thin duvet covering ~80 % of the bed width at the seat, faint 0.3 m boxes and a few big soft drapes. kn_36 has it bunched near the footwell.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/rb12/r9zoom.png (from w12base r9) vs /tmp/claude-0/rb12/t81crop.png (tpg_81). o2 plan view.
issues.fix: 09c duvetSheet: (1) Pass nu = 72 for O (roomBed: duvetSheet(bounds, z0, z1, hd, xc, 0.2, part === 'O' ? 72 : 36, 96)). Widen the dip so it is never thinner than two grid cells: 0.020*exp(-(dq/0.034)^2). (2) Better still, run the longitudinal seam in cloth space so it follows the columns: give fold() the u value and use gx = (u - 0.5)*(xr - xl)*0.9 in place of x - xc. (3) Soften the narrowing: in the O bounds, a = smooth(-0.80, -0.52, z).

issues.detail: Comforter free edge is a regular pie-crust scallop (E and O)
issues.problem: at(): xl = xl0 + 0.012*sin(23z) + 0.008*sin(41z + 1) gives a 2 cm sinusoidal edge with a 15-27 cm period. In plan (o3) and close up (r9 top-left) it reads as a crimped hem. In tpg_81 the hems are straight-ish; any waviness comes from a few long drapes.
issues.evidence: o3_bedE_plan (scalloped left edge along the whole sheet), r9zoom (top edge).
issues.fix: 09c at(): xl = xl0 + 0.006*sin(z*5.5 + 0.7) + 0.002*sin(z*17), which is long and low.

issues.detail: Buckle hidden under the slipper pouch; belt is a short slab that stops short of the seat crease
issues.problem: The belt is gBox(0.045, 0.004, 0.46) at CU (0.14, 0.047, 0) rotated -0.5 rad, so its rear end stops ~0.1 m in front of the crease (the cushion runs z ±0.30 in CU). The buckle at CU (0.06, 0.051, -0.10) sits under the navy pouch (roomBundle P = x + ps*0.29). kn_17 and c_27315 show a dark teal strap emerging from the crease, with a large silver buckle (~6 x 4 cm) in plain view at its front end and the latch plate opposite it.
issues.evidence: o1_belt_top: a strap shows, no buckle. kn_17: buckle at the lower right, #bac0c6, belt #1f3445. c_27315: belt from the crease to the buckle at the front.
issues.fix: 09c roomSeatCore: belt gBox(0.045, 0.004, 0.54) at M4.trs(0.15, 0.047, 0.04, -0.45), so its rear end tucks into the crease. Buckle gRBox(0.06, 0.014, 0.042) at the belt's front end, about CU (0.27, 0.051, -0.20), clear of the bundle. Belt colour '#30505a' -> '#24404c' (kn_17 #1f3445).

issues.detail: Pillow jacquard motif: staggered bricks rather than a diamond check
issues.problem: o5 shows rows of offset rectangles (a brick or stair pattern) at ~15 % contrast. kn_17, tpg_76 and tpg_81 show small squares set on the diagonal in nested diamond (lozenge) bands, tone-on-tone at ~8-10 % contrast. The main tree's work in progress replaces the layer with a houndstooth tile cut from tpg_46. The real-photo evidence here (kn_17 at 1300 px, tpg_76/81 at 1600 px) shows a diamond check, not houndstooth.
issues.evidence: o5_pillow_close vs kn_17 (pillow face) and tpg_81 (blue pillow).
issues.fix: In the pillow layer (03_tex.js LAYER 9 / the new jPillow tile): rotate the check 45 deg (u' = u + v, v' = u - v) with a ~2 cm cell and modulate it by a diamond band, step(fract(|u'| + |v'|), 0.5). Keep the amplitude near 0.09.
